items.name: lingsante-3.1-air-vl
items.description:
We are officially introducing LingSante-3.1-air-VL, a lightweight native multimodal model designed for real-world healthcare applications. Built on Ling-3.0-flash-VL, it has 124B total parameters with only 5.5B activated during inference. It natively supports text, image, and video inputs and a context window of up to 256K tokens, balancing medical multimodal understanding, medical text reasoning, and deployment efficiency.

Ling-3.1-air-VL-Sante excels in core medical scenarios. It ranks first on imaging report evaluations including CheXpert_Plus, IU_XRAY, and mimic_cxr, and first overall on application-specific evaluations involving photos of skin, food, and medical reports. It also ranks first on medical multimodal benchmarks including OmniMedVQA, PATH-VQA, and SLAKE, and places in the top tier on complex reasoning benchmarks such as MedXpertQA-MM, while delivering strong medical text capabilities. Beyond healthcare, the model maintains strong performance in general multimodal tasks, document and chart understanding, and tool-based tasks such as multimodal search and GUI agents—extending its capabilities from understanding to explanation and action.

Ling-3.1-air-VL-Sante 在核心医疗场景中表现突出：CheXpert_Plus、IU_XRAY、mimic_cxr 等影像报告评测均位列第一；拍皮肤、拍食物、拍医疗报告等业务评测整体位列第一；OmniMedVQA、PATH-VQA、SLAKE 等医疗多模态评测位列第一，MedXpertQA-MM 等复杂推理评测进入第一梯队；医疗文本能力同样表现优异。除医疗外，模型在通用多模、文档/图表理解，以及多模态搜索、GUI Agent 等工具类任务上保持强劲表现，能够从“看懂”进一步走向“解释”和“操作”。

items.name: lingsante-3.1-flash
items.description:
LingSante-3.1-flash is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model designed to advance capabilities across health and medicine. Built on Ling-3.1-flash, it contains 560 billion total parameters, activates approximately 25 billion parameters per token, and supports context lengths of up to 1 million tokens.
The model is developed through medical continual pretraining, mixed mid-training, supervised fine-tuning, domain-specialized reinforcement learning, and multi-teacher On-Policy distillation. While retaining strong general capabilities in knowledge, reasoning, coding, and tool use, it substantially strengthens four areas: medical knowledge and complex reasoning, professional behavior and communication boundaries, evidence-based retrieval and synthesis, and long-horizon medical workflows involving multi-turn interaction and tool use.
Ling-3.1-flash-Sante is suitable for medical question answering, complex case analysis, clinical document understanding, professional health communication, evidence retrieval and synthesis, and medical agent research. It brings medical reasoning, professional behavior, external evidence acquisition, and long-horizon task execution together within a unified model while preserving competitive general reasoning and agentic capabilities.

模型经过医学领域持续预训练、混合中期训练、监督微调、分领域强化学习和多教师 On-Policy 蒸馏，在保持通用知识、推理、代码与工具使用能力的同时，重点增强四个方面的能力：医学知识理解与复杂推理、符合专业边界的医疗沟通与行为决策、面向循证问题的深度检索与证据综合，以及需要多轮交互和工具调用的长程医疗工作流执行。
Ling-3.1-flash-Sante 适用于医学问答、复杂病例分析、临床资料理解、专业健康沟通、医学证据检索与综合，以及医疗 Agent 等研究和应用场景。模型将医学推理、专业行为、外部证据获取和长程任务执行整合到统一模型中，并保持了具有竞争力的通用推理和 Agent 能力。

items.name: lingdt-decision-fast-1.0
items.description: LingDT-Decision (Ling version) is an in-house System One model developed by Ant Digital Technologies for decision-making tasks across the software development lifecycle. # -*-  coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
lingdt-tts-cc-2.0 实时语音合成最小示例(经 MaaS 网关)

端点: wss://maas-api.antdigital.com/api-ws/v1/realtime(WebSocket 流式接口)
模型: lingdt-tts-cc-2.0
依赖: pip install dashscope

注意:
  - 服务器返回 PCM 24kHz/单声道/16bit, 客户端自行写 WAV 头保存
  - voice 必须在服务 README 的发音人列表中(README 例: maxiaojun_enhanced);
    不在列表中的音色(如百炼常用的 Cherry)不会报错, 但返回空音频, 需自检。
  - 偶发: 网关对该模型的 WS 连接会 5s 内握手不成功, 重试即可。

运行:
    python3 tts_example_simple.py

输出:
    当前目录 output.wav
"""

import base64
import threading
import wave

import dashscope
from dashscope.audio.qwen_tts_realtime import (
    AudioFormat,
    QwenTtsRealtime,
    QwenTtsRealtimeCallback,
)

API_KEY = "sk-your-maas-api-key"     # ← 替换为你的 MaaS API Key
MODEL = "lingdt-tts-cc-2.0"
WS_URL = "wss://maas-api.antdigital.com/api-ws/v1/realtime"

TEXT = "您好,这是通过 MaaS 网关调用 lingdt-tts-cc-2.0 合成的语音。"
VOICE = "maxiaojun_enhanced"         # 发音人 ID, 见 README(区分大小写)
OUT_WAV = "output.wav"
TIMEOUT_S = 180


class CollectCallback(QwenTtsRealtimeCallback):
    """收集 PCM 分片, 标记会话结束/错误。"""

    def __init__(self):
        self.audio = bytearray()
        self.finished = threading.Event()
        self.error = None

    def on_event(self, event):
        et = event.get("type", "")
        if et == "response.audio.delta":
            self.audio.extend(base64.b64decode(event["delta"]))
        elif et == "error":
            self.error = event
            self.finished.set()
        elif et == "session.finished":
            self.finished.set()


def main():
    dashscope.api_key = API_KEY

    cb = CollectCallback()
    client = QwenTtsRealtime(model=MODEL, callback=cb, url=WS_URL)

    try:
        client.connect()
        client.update_session(
            voice=VOICE,
            response_format=AudioFormat.PCM_24000HZ_MONO_16BIT,
            mode="server_commit",   # 服务端按句末标点自动断句流式返回
        )
        client.append_text(TEXT)
        client.finish()

        if not cb.finished.wait(TIMEOUT_S):
            raise TimeoutError(f"{TIMEOUT_S}s 内未收到 session.finished")
        if cb.error:
            raise RuntimeError(f"服务端返回错误: {cb.error}")
        if not cb.audio:
            raise RuntimeError(
                "未收到音频数据: 请检查 voice 是否在 README 支持的音色列表中"
                "(无效音色会静默返回空音频, 不会报错)"
            )

        with wave.open(OUT_WAV, "wb") as w:
            w.setnchannels(1)
            w.setsampwidth(2)
            w.setframerate(24000)

items.name: minimax-m3.1-flash
items.description: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash is a multimodal model from MiniMax. Compared with M3, it delivers significant improvements across multiple benchmarks, particularly in complex agentic tasks, coding, and cybersecurity. It is built for complex, multi-step co-work automation, understanding real codebases, fixing bugs, and building features, and visual understanding and creation, including frontend and presentation creation. Open weights are planned.
items.zhDescription: MiniMax-M3.1-Flash 是 MiniMax 推出的多模态模型。相比 M3，其在多项基准测试中显著提升，尤其擅长复杂智能体任务、编程与网络安全。模型面向复杂的多步骤协作自动化，可理解真实代码库、修复缺陷、开发功能，并支持视觉理解与内容创作，包括前端界面和演示文稿生成。模型权重计划后续开放。

items.name: atria-dawn
items.description: Atria Dawn is an agentic foundation model developed by the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory for complex, long-horizon tasks in real-world environments. It can interpret requirements, use tools, and adapt its actions based on execution feedback, supporting planning, implementation, validation, and iterative refinement across multi-step workflows. The model is suited for scientific research, software development, CAD design, knowledge visualization, presentation creation, data analysis, and cybersecurity, with an emphasis on delivering verifiable, usable outcomes end to end.
items.zhDescription: Atria Dawn 是上海人工智能实验室推出的智能体基础模型，面向真实世界中的复杂长程任务。模型能够理解任务需求、调用工具，并根据执行反馈持续调整行动，在多步骤工作中完成规划、执行、验证与迭代。适用于科学研究、软件开发、CAD 设计、知识可视化、演示文稿制作、数据分析及网络安全等场景，强调从任务目标到可验证、可交付成果的端到端完成能力。模型覆盖四类核心智能体能力，重点支持科研自动化与办公等真实生产力场景的端到端交付：探索，包括证据检索与整理、深度研究及实验方案设计；创造，包括软件、交互式应用、游戏、数据可视化与机器学习系统开发；交付，将文档、数据和设计需求转化为报告、演示文稿等结构化成果；网络安全，在授权环境中分析安全问题、验证漏洞、实施修复并进行复测。

items.name: mimo-v2.6-pro-ultraspeed
items.description: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-UltraSpeed is the fast speed edition of Xiaomi's flagship foundation model, MiMo-V2.6-Pro. Built from the same 1T MiMo-V2.6-Pro checkpoint, it matches the original model in quality while delivering roughly 10x the output speed. The model features a 1M-token context window and native multimodal capabilities. Optimized for agentic workflows, it delivers top-tier performance across coding, visual, general, and research scenarios, excelling at complex, long-horizon tasks with robust generalization across a diverse range of agent harnesses.
items.zhDescription: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-UltraSpeed 是小米旗舰基座模型 MiMo-V2.6-Pro 的高速版本，基于同一套 1T 参数模型权重构建，在保持原版模型效果的同时，将输出速度提升约 10 倍。模型具备 100 万 Token 上下文窗口与原生多模态能力，并针对智能体工作流深度优化，在编程、视觉、通用任务和研究场景中表现出色。面对复杂长程任务，它能够适配多种智能体框架，并保持稳健的泛化能力。

items.name: step-5-preview
items.description: Step 5 Preview is a flagship foundation model designed for real-world agentic tasks. It delivers frontier-level performance in AI coding, software engineering, and professional knowledge work, with particularly strong capabilities in finance. Built on a sparse MoE architecture, the model has 600B total parameters with 27B activated per token, and supports a 1M-token context window and visual inputs.
items.zhDescription: Step 5 Preview，一款面向真实世界 Agentic 任务的旗舰基座模型。Step 5 Preview 在 AI 编程、软件工程、专业知识工作等任务上达到前沿水平，并在金融领域展现出尤为突出的能力。Step 5 Preview 采用稀疏 MoE 架构，总参数量 600B，每个 Token 激活 27B 参数，支持 1M Token 上下文窗口和视觉输入。

items.name: ling-3.0-flash-sante
items.description: Ling-3.0-Flash-Sante is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with enhanced capabilities across health and medicine. Built on Ling-3.0-Flash, it has 124 billion total parameters and activates approximately 5.1 billion parameters per token. The model excels in medical knowledge reasoning, clinical safety, evidence-based retrieval, and long-horizon medical tasks, while retaining strong general capabilities in reasoning, coding, and agentic tasks.
items.zhDescription: Ling-3.0-flash-Sante 是一个健康和医疗能力增强的 MoE 模型。基于 Ling-3.0-flash （总参数 1240 亿参数、每 Token 激活约 51 亿）打造。模型擅长解决医学知识推理、临床安全边界、循证检索和长程医疗任务，并兼顾通用推理、代码与 Agent 能力。

items.name: jev-1.13
items.description: Jev is a structured decision model from TypeSafe, and the first of its System One models. System One models make fast, structured decisions for software, returning a typed choice rather than free-form text. It is suited for routing, classification, and other decision points inside an application where a fast, predictable answer matters more than generated prose.
items.zhDescription: Jev 是 TypeSafe 推出的结构化决策模型，也是其首款 System One（系统一）模型。该系列面向软件系统快速完成结构化判断，输出类型化的选择结果，而非自由文本。适用于应用内的路由、分类及其他决策节点，尤其适合注重响应速度和结果可预测性的场景。

items.name: lingdt-ocr-1.1
items.description: A large model developed by Ant Digital Technologies specifically for document parsing. Deeply optimized for this task, it features a compact model size and fast response times while delivering high-accuracy results for text, formulas, and tables in images.
items.zhDescription: 蚂蚁数科专门面向文档解析使用构建的大模型，针对文档解析深度定制，参数少，响应快，针对文本/公式/表格图片给出高精度的结果

items.name: kimi-k2.8-preview
items.description: Kimi K2.8 Preview delivers overall performance close to K3 with more efficient thinking. It supports adjustable thinking effort levels aligned with K3’s reasoning tiers, and provides up to 1M-token ultra-long context.
items.zhDescription: 综合性能接近 K3，思考（thinking）效率更高；支持 thinking effort 档位调节（与 K3 的思考等级一致）；支持 1M 超长上下文。

items.name: wan3.0-video-prime
items.description: Wan3.0-Video-Prime is the high-speed variant of Wan3.0, matching the capabilities of the standard Wan3.0-Video model. It supports versatile four-modal references and generates videos up to 30 seconds, delivering immersive audiovisual experiences with significantly faster end-to-end generation.
items.zhDescription: Wan3.0-Video-Prime 是万相3.0 的高速版视频生成模型，能力对齐 Wan3.0-Video 标准版，支持四模态全能参考，最长可生成30秒视频，带来沉浸式视听体验的同时端到端速度显著提升。

items.name: glm-5.3-flashx
items.description: GLM-5.3-FlashX is a faster and smoother version of GLM-5.3-Flash, delivering inference speeds of up to 200 tokens/s. GLM-5.3-FlashX is a native multimodal model from Z.ai. It is suited for efficient coding and long-horizon agent tasks. Its hybrid sparse and linear attention architecture maintains accurate long-context behavior while reducing compute overhead.
items.zhDescription: GLM-5.3-FlashX 是 GLM-5.3-Flash 更快、更流畅的版本，推理速度最高可达 200 tokens/s。作为 Z.ai 推出的原生多模态模型，它适用于高效编程与长程智能体任务。其稀疏注意力与线性注意力混合架构，可在降低计算开销的同时保持准确的长上下文处理能力。

items.name: ling-3.0-flash-vl
items.description: Ling-3.0-flash-VL builds on Ling-3.0-flash, further strengthening its language capabilities while adding native visual perception and advanced visual agent capabilities.
items.zhDescription: 新一代原生多模态大模型，拥有 124B 总参数量，单次激活参数仅 5.5B，融合语言理解、视觉感知与复杂推理能力，可处理图片、图表、文档和界面等多种信息，并针对 Coding Agent、Search Agent、企业知识工作流及高频多轮对话进行重点优化，在保持强劲模型能力的同时兼顾响应速度与调用效率。

items.name: mimo-v2.6-flash
items.description: MiMo-V2.6-Flash is an open-source foundation model developed by Xiaomi. Built on a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with 309B total parameters and 15B activated per token, it employs a hybrid attention mechanism for greater computational efficiency. The model features a 1M-token context window and native multimodal capabilities. Optimized for agentic workflows, it delivers strong performance across coding, visual, general, and research scenarios, excelling at complex, long-horizon tasks with robust generalization across a diverse range of agent harnesses.
items.zhDescription: MiMo-V2.6-Flash 是小米研发的开源基座模型，采用 MoE 架构，总参数量为 309B，每个 Token 激活 15B 参数，并通过混合注意力机制提升计算效率。模型具备 100 万 Token 上下文窗口与原生多模态能力，并针对智能体工作流深度优化，在编程、视觉、通用任务和研究场景中表现出色。面对复杂长程任务，它能够适配多种智能体框架，并保持稳健的泛化能力。

items.name: qwen-image-3.0-pro
items.description: Qwen Image 3 Pro is an image generation and editing model from Qwen. It supports precise rendering of text and details as small as 10px, along with richer world knowledge compared to previous generations.
items.zhDescription: 内容丰实：支持最大 4.5k token 输入，支持图中图密集信息排版，让报纸、分镜、菜单、试卷等复杂版面一次生成。 细节真实：支持 10px 小字精准渲染，微表情、毛孔、发丝等细节生动还原，逼近真实摄影的质感。 知识厚实：支持 12 国语言、多种字体原生渲染，主流网页、游戏、直播等界面仿真，外部知识全纳入。 Qwen-Image-3.0-Pro 不只是在追求"好看"，更在追求“好用”——让图像生成真正成为可落地的生产力工具。

items.name: mimo-v2.6-pro
items.description: MiMo-V2.6-Pro is the flagship foundation model developed by Xiaomi. Built at a scale of over 1T parameters, it is designed to push the ceiling of capability for the most demanding workloads. The model features a 1M-token context window and native multimodal capabilities. Optimized for agentic workflows, it delivers top-tier performance across coding, visual, general, and research scenarios, excelling at complex, long-horizon tasks with robust generalization across a diverse range of agent harnesses.
items.zhDescription: MiMo-V2.6-Pro 是小米研发的旗舰基座模型，参数规模超过 1T，面向高强度工作负载进一步提升模型能力上限。模型具备 100 万 Token 上下文窗口与原生多模态能力，并针对智能体工作流深度优化，在编程、视觉、通用任务和研究场景中表现出色。面对复杂长程任务，它能够适配多种智能体框架，并保持稳健的泛化能力。

items.name: deepseek-flash
items.description: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is a 552B-parameter MoE model built on a new causal encoder-decoder architecture, designed for higher capability, faster reasoning, higher throughput, and lower serving cost. It natively supports multimodal visual understanding and delivers flagship-level intelligence with significantly reduced KV cache requirements, making it well suited for high-throughput and cost-sensitive agentic workloads.
items.zhDescription: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 是一款 552B 参数的 MoE 模型，采用全新的因果编码器—解码器架构，在模型能力、推理速度与吞吐量方面进一步提升，同时降低服务成本。模型原生支持多模态视觉理解，并通过显著减少 KV Cache 需求实现旗舰级智能表现，适合高吞吐、成本敏感的智能体工作负载。

items.name: kimi-k3
items.description: Kimi K3 is Kimi’s most capable flagship model to date. With 2.8 trillion parameters, it is built on Kimi Delta Attention (KDA), a hybrid linear attention architecture, and Attention Residuals. The model natively supports visual understanding and features a 1-million-token context window. As the world’s first open-source model in the 3-trillion-parameter class, Kimi K3 is designed for frontier workloads such as long-horizon coding, knowledge work, and reasoning.

items.name: deepseek-v4-flash-0731
items.description:
The official 0731 version.DeepSeek-V4-Flash is the efficiency-oriented variant of the DeepSeek V4 series, released as a preview and open-sourced alongside the flagship V4-Pro. It is designed for developers who need the V4 generation's long-context and reasoning capability at a faster, more economical API tier. Compared with V4-Pro, V4-Flash uses smaller total parameters and active parameters, resulting in faster response times and lower API cost. It retains reasoning capability close to V4-Pro and matches V4-Pro on simple agent tasks, with a measurable gap appearing only on the most demanding agent workflows. World knowledge is slightly below V4-Pro but remains competitive within the open-source landscape.

Like V4-Pro, V4-Flash inherits the new attention mechanism built on token-dimension compression and DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA), supports a 1M context window as standard, and offers both thinking and non-thinking modes with a reasoning_effort parameter (high / max).

Note on migration: the legacy model names deepseek-chat and deepseek-reasoner currently route to V4-Flash in non-thinking and thinking mode respectively, and will be retired on 2026-07-24. Existing integrations should migrate to the explicit model names deepseek-v4-flash or deepseek-v4-pro. The model is accessible via OpenAI ChatCompletions and Anthropic interfaces, with weights open-sourced on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
items.zhDescription: V4-Flash 0731正式版，高效轻量化MoE模型，总参284B，激活13B，原生支持百万超长上下文能力。推理速度快、延迟低、调用成本低廉，综合能力均衡，主打高并发、轻量化任务，适合日常对话、内容创作、基础 RAG、批量文案处理等普惠刚需场景。

items.name: minimax-m2.7
items.description:
MiniMax-M2.7 is a next-generation large language model designed for autonomous, real-world productivity and continuous improvement. Built to actively participate in its own evolution, M2.7 integrates advanced agentic capabilities through multi-agent collaboration, enabling it to plan, execute, and refine complex tasks across dynamic environments.

Trained for production-grade performance, M2.7 handles workflows such as live debugging, root cause analysis, financial modeling, and full document generation across Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. It delivers strong results on benchmarks including 56.2% on SWE-Pro and 57.0% on Terminal Bench 2, while achieving a 1495 ELO on GDPval-AA, setting a new standard for multi-agent systems operating in real-world digital workflows.
items.zhDescription: MiniMax M2.7在现实软件工程中表现卓越，涵盖端到端完整项目交付、日志分析与故障分类、代码安全、机器学习等领域。在 SWE-Pro 基准测试中，M2.7 得分为 56.22%，几乎达到了 Opus 的水平。这种能力也延伸至端到端完整项目交付场景（VIBE-Pro 55.6%）以及对 Terminal Bench 2 上复杂工程系统的深度理解（57.0%）。在专业办公领域，我们提升了模型在各个领域的专业知识和任务交付能力。在 GDPval-AA 上，其 ELO 分数为 1495，是开源模型中最高的。M2.7 在 Office 套件（Excel/PPT/Word）中执行复杂编辑的能力显著提高，能够实现更好的多轮修订和高保真编辑。M2.7 具备与复杂环境交互的能力。在 40 个复杂技能（> 2000 tokens）案例中，M2.7 仍保持了 97% 的技能遵循率。在 OpenClaw 使用方面，相比 M2.5，M2.7 展现了显著提升，在 MMClaw 评估中得分接近最新的 Sonnet 4.6。M2.7 拥有出色的身份保持能力和情商。除了生产力用例之外，它还为互动娱乐场景的创新开辟了空间。

items.description: HappyHorse 1.0 T2V is an open-source text-to-video generation model from Alibaba DAMO Academy’s Future Life Lab. Built on a 15B-parameter single-stream self-attention Transformer architecture, it is designed to understand complex camera language, spatial relationships, and multi-character scenes, enabling high-quality 1080P video generation from text prompts. {"exampleCodes":{"dashscope":[{"code":"import os
import base64
import threading
import time
import dashscope
from dashscope.audio.qwen_tts_realtime import *

qwen_tts_realtime: QwenTtsRealtime = None
text_to_synthesize = [
    '对吧~我就特别喜欢这种超市，',
    '尤其是过年的时候',
    '去逛超市',
    '就会觉得',
    '超级超级开心！',
    '想买好多好多的东西呢！'
]

DO_VIDEO_TEST = False

def init_dashscope_api_key():
    """
        Set your DashScope API-key. More information:
        https://github.com/aliyun/alibabacloud-bailian-speech-demo/blob/master/PREREQUISITES.md
    """

    if 'DASHSCOPE_API_KEY' in os.environ:
        dashscope.api_key = os.environ['DASHSCOPE_API_KEY']
    else:
        dashscope.api_key = 'your-dashscope-api-key'
    # 全局配置WebSocket请求地址，所有实时TTS共用这个地址
    dashscope.base_websocket_api_url = "wss://maas-api.antdigital.com/api-ws/v1/realtime"


class MyCallback(QwenTtsRealtimeCallback):
    def __init__(self):
        self.complete_event = threading.Event()
        self.file = open('result_24k.pcm', 'wb')

    def on_open(self) -> None:
        print('connection opened, init player')

    def on_close(self, close_status_code, close_msg) -> None:
        self.file.close()
        print('connection closed with code: {}, msg: {}, destroy player'.format(close_status_code, close_msg))

    def on_event(self, response: dict) -> None:
        try:
            global qwen_tts_realtime
            type_val = response['type']
            if 'session.created' == type_val:
                print('start session: {}'.format(response['session']['id']))
            if 'response.audio.delta' == type_val:
                recv_audio_b64 = response['delta']
                self.file.write(base64.b64decode(recv_audio_b64))
            if 'response.done' == type_val:
                print(f'response {qwen_tts_realtime.get_last_response_id()} done')
            if 'session.finished' == type_val:
                print('session finished')
                self.complete_event.set()
        except Exception as e:
            print('[Error] {}'.format(e))
            return

    def wait_for_finished(self):
        self.complete_event.wait()


if __name__  == '__main__':
    init_dashscope_api_key()

    print('Initializing ...')

    callback = MyCallback()

    # 不再单独传入url，自动读取全局配置的websocket地址
    qwen_tts_realtime = QwenTtsRealtime(
        model='qwen3-tts-flash-realtime',
        callback=callback,
    )

    qwen_tts_realtime.connect()
    qwen_tts_realtime.update_session(
        voice = 'Cherry',
        response_format = AudioFormat.PCM_24000HZ_MONO_16BIT,
        mode = 'server_commit'
    )
    for text_chunk in text_to_synthesize:
        print(f'send text: {text_chunk}')
        qwen_tts_realtime.append_text(text_chunk)
        time.sleep(0.1)
    qwen_tts_realtime.finish()
    callback.wait_for_finished()
    print('[Metric] session: {}, first audio delay: {}'.format(
                    qwen_tts_realtime.get_session_id(),
                    qwen_tts_realtime.get_first_audio_delay(),
                    ))","sectionTitle":"","name":"python"}]}}

{"exampleCodes":{"dashscope":[{"code":"import base64

MODEL = "lingdt-asr-cc-0.6b"
WS_URL = "wss://maas-api.antdigital.com/api-ws/v1/realtime"

class ASRCallback(OmniRealtimeCallback):
    def __init__(self):
        self.transcript = ""
        self.session_ready = False
        self.session_done = False

    def on_event(self, message):
        event_type = message.get("type")
        if event_type == "session.updated":
            self.session_ready = True
        elif event_type == "conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.completed":
            self.transcript = message.get("transcript", "")
        elif event_type == "session.finished":
            self.session_done = True

def run_asr(pcm_path: Path):

    cb = ASRCallback()
    conv = OmniRealtimeConversation(model=MODEL, url=WS_URL, callback=cb)

        conv.connect()
        # 会话配置，仅保留ASR有效参数
        conv.update_session(
            output_modalities=[MultiModality.TEXT],
            enable_input_audio_transcription=True,
            enable_turn_detection=True,

            turn_detection_silence_duration_ms=400,
            turn_detection_threshold=0.0,

        while not cb.session_ready:
            time.sleep(0.1)

                conv.append_audio(base64.b64encode(chunk).decode("ascii"))
                time.sleep(0.1)

        conv.end_session_async()
        while not cb.session_done:
            time.sleep(0.1)
        print("识别结果：", cb.transcript)
    finally:
        conv.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":

items.description:
Atria Dawn Preview is a preview version of a new-generation agentic model developed by the Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory. Trained on a 744B-parameter MoE foundation model, it is designed for research and engineering scenarios that require continuous environmental understanding, tool use, and multi-step task completion. The model helps users drive open-ended problems toward executable, verifiable, and reproducible results. It can support problem analysis, solution design, tool use, code implementation, experiment execution, result analysis, and failure recovery by combining task objectives with environmental feedback.

Atria Dawn Preview empowers agentic tasks across four dimensions, with a particular focus on end-to-end delivery in real-world productivity scenarios such as scientific automation and office work: Discovery: Retrieving and organizing evidence, conducting deep research, and turning research questions into executable experimental plans. Creation: Building software, interactive applications, games, data visualizations, and machine learning systems. Delivery: Transforming documents, data, and design requirements into reports, presentations, and other structured deliverables. Cybersecurity: Analyzing security issues, validating vulnerabilities, applying fixes, and performing re-validation in authorized environments.

items.name: qwen-long
items.description: Qwen-Long is a large language model developed by Qwen for ultra-long-context processing. It supports Chinese, English, and other languages, with a context window of up to 10 million tokens—equivalent to approximately 15 million Chinese characters or 15,000 pages. Together with its document service, it can parse and interact with text files (TXT, DOCX, PDF, XLSX, EPUB, MOBI, MD, and CSV) and image files (BMP, PNG, JPG/JPEG, GIF, and scanned PDFs). Direct HTTP requests support up to 1 million tokens; file-based submission is recommended for longer inputs.
